conversation_transcript.text: 🦷 PerioVoice AI: Hi! Tell me what’s bothering you about your teeth or gums today. You can describe it in your own words.
Hello! 👋 I'm PerioVoice AI, your dental triage assistant. How can I help you today? Tell me what's bothering you with your teeth or gums.
Tooth pain can be uncomfortable. Can you please tell me where in your mouth the pain is located, such as the upper right gum, back molars, or front teeth?
Upper gum pain can be concerning. How long has this been going on? (e.g., a few days, a week, or longer?)
Pain that persists for a week may need some attention. Does it happen every time, or only now and then?
Consistent pain can be a challenge. Does anything specific set it off — like brushing, hot/cold food, or chewing?
Bleeding while brushing is a common symptom. Does the bleeding happen when you brush normally, or only when you brush harder?

recommendation: 🟢 LOW RISK: Maintain daily oral hygiene and routine dental checkups.
home_care_tips: Brush twice daily using soft bristles angled at 45 degrees to the gumline.
Floss gently between all teeth once daily.
Rinse with warm salt water or an alcohol-free antimicrobial rinse.
